_comment: Copy to ~/.config/whisper-alternative/config.json (install.sh does this). Hotkeys use ctrl, alt, cmd, shift joined with +. Language = Whisper ISO code or 'auto'. Model = file name inside models_dir. Empty models_dir / sounds_dir mean the 'models' / 'sounds' folders next to config.json. Set a sound to "" for silence. Mode names are case-insensitive.
